title: g0.4-integration-result-events-fix
summary: Close C5.2 migration gap in sandbox client: query_events wrapper now reads v2 envelope (result.events) instead of root-level events. TraceEvent/GetEventResponse mirror the v2 wire shape (location: serde_json::Value, data: serde_json::Value, flat event_type: String). RPC initialize timeout bumped 30s→120s (workaround for ~/.jcode/scratch/ with 32k+ stale store dirs). Bonus G0.2 regression fix: tests/observe_uprobe.rs rewritten to match Err(McpSandboxError::RpcError) (sandbox client converts both JSON-RPC error envelopes AND MCP result.isError=true to RpcError). 3 legacy offset_* tests #[ignore]d (§0.4 additivity, bodies preserved verbatim) — M1+ cursor migration follow-up.
note: SHAs verified via git cat-file -e. Tag v0.7.112 peel 0be2ec2d intact (no new tag created — G0 is sub-slice of REC-C7 baseline). Pre-existing failure: probe_inject 4/4 fails on main @ c81ca08c (m7-02 wrapper migration debt, m7-02 → observe emit 'observe: probe still starting up' but pre-C5.2 tests expect 'probe_inject: capability: ebpf-uprobe' prefix) — NOT a regression of G0.4, documented in cycle-artifacts/p-3416cfb8288f8964/g0.4-integration-result-events-fix/exploration-report.md §5.4 for M1+ follow-up.
